g.title: 900019->END_NODE
g.text: Level 1: High risk of disclosure, investigations taking place, situation being monitored. Relock essential.

g.title: 900019->END_NODE
g.text: Level 2: Medium risk of disclosure, situation being monitored to establish if a relock is necessary. Relock possible.

g.title: 900019->END_NODE
g.text: Level 3: Low risk of disclosure, minor incident that may have disclosed the key or lock systems. Small chance of relock.

g.title: 900019->END_NODE
g.text: Level 4: Very low risk of disclosure, but a notifiable minor incident that may have compromised the key or lock systems but has not led to a disclosure. No relock.

g.title: 900019->END_NODE
g.text: Level 5: No risk of disclosure. No relock.
In prisoners' possession (not including them wearing them)
